# from the LEGUS star cluster catalog (Adamo et al. 2017, ApJ, 841, 131), file
#   hlsp_legus_hst_acs-wfc3_ngc628-c_multiband_v1_padagb-mwext-avgapcor.tab
# as downloaded from https://archive.stsci.edu/prepds/legus/cluster_catalogs/ngc628-c.html
# The clusters are a subset of the catalog's high-confidence sample (visual classes 1-3),
# all detected in all five bands; every field other than the source ID, the photometry, and
# its errors has been removed.
#
# Columns: ID is the source ID in the catalog file above (its first column); the others are
# the magnitude and photometric error (mag) in each band. F275W and F336W are HST WFC3/UVIS
# (slug filters HST.WFC3_UVIS1.F275W, HST.WFC3_UVIS1.F336W); F435W, F555W, and F814W are
# HST ACS/WFC (HST.ACS_WFC.F435W, HST.ACS_WFC.F555W, HST.ACS_WFC.F814W).
# Magnitudes are apparent Vega magnitudes, corrected for Galactic foreground extinction and
# for aperture losses (average aperture correction). To convert to absolute magnitudes,
# subtract the distance modulus of 29.98 mag (9.9 Mpc; Calzetti et al. 2015, AJ, 149, 51).
